aggregation: Arithmetic mean; median and observed min/max also retained; n=3 per successful variant.
completion_definition: Copy start through destination sync and count/size validation, including harness overhead.
copy_definition: Complete copy command invocation wall time, including command startup.

selection_policy.purpose: Practical performance guide for HPC administrators, SREs and software developers, to live in the repository.
selection_policy.selection: Use the latest successful sample per equivalent command configuration and repetition; never choose by speed.
selection_policy.dcp_aliases: dcp-default and dcp-32 both mean 32 MPI ranks; select latest after verifying commands and sources match.

remote_comparability.basis: Experiment owner confirmed equivalent hosts and authorized updated rcp results against existing baselines.
remote_comparability.qualification: The comparison uses equivalent hosts. Measurement dates and build identifiers remain in provenance; the report and figures omit measurement chronology.

local_xfs_comparability.basis: Experiment owner confirmed equivalent hosts for the local rcp rerun and supplied the missing baseline results.
local_xfs_comparability.qualification: The comparison uses equivalent hosts. Measurement dates and build identifiers remain in provenance; the report and figures omit measurement chronology.

selection_policy.reflink: XFS cloning used by rcp and cp is a fair, intended default feature. Dcp copies data. Elapsed time is measured, not physical byte throughput.

zfs_arc.caveat: We could not fully eliminate ZFS ARC effects from these measurements.
zfs_arc.dcp_selection: For each fileset, the later of two equivalent 32-rank dcp trial sets also had the lower mean command wall time. All three repetitions from that set are retained; no individual minimum or different rank count is substituted.
zfs_arc.rcp_expectation: ZFS block cloning is the reflink equivalent: cloned files share existing data blocks. When cloning succeeds, rcp avoids reading and copying the file payload and is expected to be less sensitive to source-data ARC state. Metadata caching can still affect timings.
zfs_arc.evidence_limit: Cache effects were not isolated experimentally. The supplied archive does not include clone-success counters or syscall traces; the block-cloning explanation is consistent with the copy path and observed timings.
zfs_arc.figure_caption:
ZFS: ARC effects could not be fully excluded. The faster equivalent 32-rank dcp trial set is shown (all 3 repetitions).
Block cloning is expected to reduce rcp's sensitivity to source-data caching; metadata caching can still affect timings.

selection_policy.timeouts: Experiment owner confirmed the two NFS serial 1 kB attempts timed out at 12 hours. Plot as right-censored, not as completed-copy times.
selection_policy.metadata: Same fresh-destination tree-copy task; CLI preservation flags differ. Reference source and a local rcp 0.41.0 experiment show plain rcp does not preserve original timestamps; exact private benchmark source is unavailable.

presentation.wall_time_axes: The network-filesystem overview uses matching base-10 logarithmic axes for Lustre, Weka and NFS, starting at 1 second (10^0), with an explicit log-scale subtitle. The local-filesystem overview and other wall-time plots use linear axes starting at zero.
presentation.overview_elapsed_time_context: The network overview also lists mean elapsed times in minutes and dcp/rcp ratios for the 1 MB fileset, keeping absolute durations visible alongside logarithmic axes.
presentation.marker_meaning: Tool identity only; larger markers identify default settings. Parallelism is labeled explicitly.
presentation.scripted_parallelism: Ten-process cp and rsync recipes partition the generated directory tree. They are independent baselines, not native parallelism options.
presentation.reader_labels: Figures use descriptive filesystem and workload names. Internal campaign IDs remain only in provenance data.
presentation.measurement_chronology: Report prose and figure captions omit measurement dates and campaign history. Timestamped records remain in provenance; reproducibility paths retain their actual filenames.
presentation.remote_concurrency: Label explicit remote settings as copy concurrency. Keep the exact max-files-in-flight and max-connections flag pair in the report's reproducibility appendix and raw commands.

coverage.basis: Generated local grid: 5 filesystems × 4 filesets; generated remote grid: 4 filesets; Linux source local and remote. Internal dcp aliases are counted separately here before selection.
